sentences.text: Ikramuddin vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:239867
Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 11293 of 2023
Applicant :- Ikramuddin

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Khalil,Mohd. Afzal Ansari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime no. 15 of 2018,
under Section 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C. and Section 13(1) C of Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station EOW, Sector Meerut with the prayer that in the event of arrest, applicant may be released on bail.

entities.text: Prevention of Corruption Act, Police Station EOW, Sector Meerut
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has an apprehension that he may be arrested in the above-mentioned case, whereas there is no credible evidence against him.
It was submitted that at the relevant time applicant was working as Manager of the Baliyan Public Junior High School, Meerut.

entities.text: Baliyan Public Junior High School, Meerut
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
As per prosecution version, in the year 2010-2011 Ikramuddin vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94627055/
1

a grant of Rs. 70,000/- was provided to the said college for scholarship of the Pre-Matric students of the Madrasa but the applicant in connivance with co-accused persons/officials of Minority Welfare Department, misappropriated the said funds and did not distribute the same amongst the students.

Learned counsel submitted that the prosecution case is based mainly on the ground that the said scholarship amount has not been transferred into the accounts of students, whereas, at that time there was no such provision.
In fact government has issued a Government Order in the year 2014 that scholarship amount has to be transferred into the accounts of students.
It is further submitted that the said scholarship amount received in the said college was distributed amongst the eligible students in cash.
The applicant undertakes to co-operate during investigation and trial and he would appear as and when required by the investigating agency or Court.

It has been stated that in case,
the applicant is granted anticipatory bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate with the investigation and would obey all conditions of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application for anticipatory bail.

5. It may be stated that in case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, it has been held by Hon'ble Supreme Court that while deciding anticipatory bail, Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. In the instant case, considering the settled principle of law regarding anticipatory bail,
submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, role of applicant and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merit of the case, a case for anticipatory bail is made out.
7. The anticipatory bail application is allowed.

2 9.
In default of any of the conditions, the Investigating Officer/prosecution shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the applicant.
